view.sentenceEn: But the reality is that your boss might view you very highly.
view.translationZh: 但事实是，你的老板可能对你的评价非常高。
view.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

view.sentenceEn: One of the biggest barriers to gaining buy-in occurs when the owner of an idea is viewed as argumentative, defensive, or close-minded.
view.translationZh: 获得认同的最大障碍之一是，当想法提出者被视为好辩、爱辩解或思想封闭时。
view.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

view.sentenceEn: But that's a very shortsighted view , particularly when it comes to the Chesapeake Bay.
view.translationZh: 但这种观点非常短视，尤其是对于切萨皮克湾而言。
view.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

view.sentenceEn: Most scientists and experts sharply dispute Hardy's views .
view.translationZh: 大多数科学家和专家对哈迪的观点提出了尖锐的反驳。
view.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

view.sentenceEn: Which of the following statements best represents Lownie's view ?
view.translationZh: 以下哪种说法最能代表劳尼的观点？
她表达了自相矛盾的观点。

variety.sentenceEn: I loved the man from the Thirties research who found that wireless suddenly offered "a lot of variety …things I thought I'd never be interested in…ice hockey perhaps".
variety.translationZh: 我很喜欢那项三十年代研究中的那位受访者，他发现广播突然间提供了“极其丰富的内容……那些我原以为自己永远不会感兴趣的东西……比如冰球”。
variety.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

variety.sentenceEn: Scientists have employed a variety of ways to engage the general public in their research, such as making data analysis into an online game or sample collection into a smartphone application.
variety.translationZh: 科学家们采用了多种方式让普通公众参与他们的研究，例如将数据分析转化为在线游戏，或将样本收集开发为智能手机应用程序。
variety.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

variety.sentenceEn: They move between a variety of habitats, including forests, grasslands, woodlands, wetlands and agricultural land.
variety.translationZh: 它们在多种栖息地之间迁移，包括森林、草原、林地、湿地和农田。
variety.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

variety.sentenceEn: That's why Hayden's expedition aimed to produce a fuller understanding of the Yellowstone River region, from its hot springs and waterfalls to its variety of flora and fauna.
variety.translationZh: 因此，海登的探险队旨在让人们更全面地了解黄石河流域，从那里的温泉、瀑布到丰富多样的动植物。

variety.sentenceEn: The variety of plastic objects at risk is dizzying: early radios, avant-garde sculptures, celluloid animation stills from Disney films, the first artificial heart.
variety.translationZh: 面临威胁的塑料制品种类多得令人眼花缭乱：早期的收音机、前卫雕塑、迪士尼电影的赛璐珞动画剧照，以及第一个人工心脏。
variety.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第8句

variety.sentenceEn: Of all the varieties , standard English can best convey complex ideas.
variety.translationZh: 在所有语言变体中，标准英语最能准确传达复杂思想。
variety.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）

valuable.sentenceEn: Urban planners interpret desire paths as more than just convenient shortcuts; they offer valuable insights into the dynamics between planning and behaviour.
valuable.translationZh: 城市规划师认为， desire paths 不仅仅是便捷的捷径；它们还为理解规划与行为之间的动态关系提供了宝贵见解。
valuable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

valuable.sentenceEn: The idea that one might burn down an entire house just to reclaim the nails underlines how scarce, costly and valuable the simple-seeming technology was.
valuable.translationZh: 为收回钉子而不惜烧毁整栋房屋的想法，凸显了这项看似简单的技术在当时是多么稀缺、昂贵且珍贵。
valuable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

valuable.sentenceEn: This was an attempt to recover the valuable nails, which could be reused after sifting the ashes.
valuable.translationZh: 他们这么做是为了回收那些值钱的钉子，将灰烬筛过后，这些钉子就可以重新使用。
valuable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

valuable.sentenceEn: The alliances are most valuable when scientists and artists have a shared stake in a project, are able to jointly design it and can critique each other's work.
valuable.translationZh: 当科学家和艺术家在一个项目中拥有共同的利益，能够共同设计项目并相互批评各自的工作时，这种合作联盟才最具价值。
valuable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

valuable.sentenceEn: "Machine learning often provides a more reliable form of statistics which makes data more valuable ," says Winston.
valuable.translationZh: 温斯顿表示：“机器学习往往能提供更可靠的统计方式，从而提升数据的价值。”
valuable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

various.sentenceEn: In addition, you need to be willing to stand up to scrutiny and criticism and be prepared to explain your innovation in different ways for various audiences.
various.translationZh: 此外，你需要勇于接受审视和批评，并准备好以不同方式向不同受众解释你的创新。
various.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

various.sentenceEn: Improving living standards and increasing prosperity for more people will require greater use of digital technologies to boost productivity in various sectors, including health care and construction, says Coyle.
various.translationZh: 科伊尔表示，要提高更多人的生活水平并增进繁荣，就需要更多地利用数字技术来提高包括医疗保健和建筑业在内的各个行业的生产力。
various.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

various.sentenceEn: Caravanserais served as an informal meeting point for the various people who travelled the Silk Road.
various.translationZh: 商队驿站成为了丝绸之路上各色旅人的非正式聚集地。
various.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

various.sentenceEn: Those retailers may face headaches complying with various state sales tax laws.
various.translationZh: 这些零售商可能会在遵守各州不同的销售税法方面遇到麻烦。
various.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

various.sentenceEn: I came to recognise various signs of a bad paper: the kind of paper that purports to show that people who eat more than one kilo of broccoli a week were 1.17 times more likely than those who eat less to suffer late in life from pernicious anaemia.
various.translationZh: 我逐渐识别出劣质论文的种种特征：这类论文往往声称，每周食用超过一公斤西兰花的人，晚年患恶性贫血的几率比食用量较少的人高出1.17倍。
various.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

various.sentenceEn: Rather, we ascribe meanings to texts on the basis of interaction between what we might call textual and contextual material: between kinds of organization or patterning we perceive in a text's formal structures (so especially its language structures) and various kinds of background, social knowledge, belief and attitude that we bring to the text.
various.translationZh: 相反，我们赋予文本意义是基于我们所谓的文本材料与语境材料之间的互动：一方面是我们在文本形式结构（尤其是语言结构）中感知到的各种组织方式或模式，另一方面是我们带入文本的各种背景知识、社会认知、信念和态度。

version.sentenceEn: A return to that version of scientific literacy, which focused more on teaching what science is and how it works and less on memorizing scientific facts, seems like something society today desperately needs.
version.translationZh: 回归到这种科学素养的版本，即更多地关注传授科学的本质及其运作方式，而非死记硬背科学事实，似乎正是当今社会迫切需要的。
version.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

version.sentenceEn: And despite improvements to the premium, paid version , few people were making the upgrade.
version.translationZh: 尽管高级付费版本已有所改进，但升级的用户寥寥无几。
version.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

version.sentenceEn: The problem was that too many customers were using the basic, free version of their product.
version.translationZh: 问题在于，太多客户都在使用他们产品的基础免费版。
version.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

version.sentenceEn: Most customers were simply unaware of the premium version and what it offered.
version.translationZh: 大多数客户根本不知道高级版的存在及其提供的功能。
version.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

version.sentenceEn: Armed with this insight, the marketing and engineering teams joined forces to raise awareness by prominently promoting the premium version to users of the free version .
version.translationZh: 基于这一洞见，市场营销团队与工程团队联手合作，通过向免费版用户重点推广高级版来提高用户认知度。
version.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

version.sentenceEn: More versions of IQ tests are now available on the Internet.
version.translationZh: 如今，互联网上可以找到更多版本的智商测试。
version.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）

vehicle.sentenceEn: They've helped pull wheeled vehicles , carry travelers and move goods across the world.
vehicle.translationZh: 它们曾帮助人们拉动轮式车辆、运送旅客以及在全球范围内搬运货物。
vehicle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

vehicle.sentenceEn: In this way, AI can be a fun vehicle for self-discovery.
vehicle.translationZh: 通过这种方式，人工智能可以成为自我发现的有趣媒介。
vehicle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

vehicle.sentenceEn: "The American Medical Association advises physicians that 'in situations where clear evidence of substantial driving impairment implies a strong threat to patient and public safety, and where the physician's advice to discontinue driving privileges is ignored, it is desirable and ethical to notify the Department of Motor Vehicles ,'" Menke wrote.
vehicle.translationZh: 门克写道：'美国医学协会建议医生，'当有明确证据表明驾驶员存在严重驾驶障碍，对患者本人及公共安全构成严重威胁，且医生关于终止驾驶特权的建议被忽视时，通知机动车管理部门是可取且符合伦理的做法。'
vehicle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

vehicle.sentenceEn: They set new standards for ventilation, energy efficiency and heating, and state that new residential buildings must have charging points for electric vehicles .
vehicle.translationZh: 这些新规设定了通风、能源效率和供暖方面的新标准，并规定新建住宅必须配备电动汽车充电设施。
vehicle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

vehicle.sentenceEn: That's because they inevitably put the costs of cleaning the air on to individual drivers—who must pay fees or buy better vehicles —rather than on to the car manufacturers whose cheating is the real cause of our toxic pollution.
vehicle.translationZh: 这是因为这些措施不可避免地将净化空气的成本转嫁给了个体司机——他们必须支付费用或购买更环保的车辆——而非汽车制造商，而正是这些制造商的作弊行为才是造成我们有毒污染的真正原因。
vehicle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

vehicle.sentenceEn: Restrictions that keep highly polluting cars out of certain areas—city centres, "school streets", even individual roads—are a response to the absence of a larger effort to properly enforce existing regulations and require auto companies to bring their vehicles into compliance.
vehicle.translationZh: 限制高污染车辆进入特定区域——市中心、"学校街道"乃至个别路段——是对缺乏更大力度举措的一种回应，这些本应有的举措包括恰当执行现有法规，以及要求汽车公司使其车辆符合标准。
vehicle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

vast.sentenceEn: But outside those narrow pools of interest, a vast ocean awaits, bountiful with simmering ideas, mental adventure and imaginative refreshment.
vast.translationZh: 但在那些狭隘的兴趣圈子之外，有一片浩瀚的海洋正等待着人们去探索，那里充满了各种酝酿中的思想、智力上的冒险，以及想象力的洗礼。

vast.sentenceEn: Zoos are, in that sense, similar to natural history and archeology museums, serving to satisfy our need for contact with these living creatures while leaving the vast majority undisturbed in their natural environments.
vast.translationZh: 从这个意义上说，动物园类似于自然历史博物馆和考古博物馆，它们满足了我们与这些生物接触的需求，同时让绝大多数生物在其自然环境中不受打扰。
vast.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第1句

vast.sentenceEn: Of course, I need to concede that my collection of 'Smiling Victorians' makes up only a tiny percentage of the vast catalogue of photographic portraiture created between 1840 and 1900, the majority of which show sitters posing miserably and stiffly in front of painted backdrops, or staring absently into the middle distance.
vast.translationZh: 当然，我必须承认，我收集的这些'微笑的维多利亚人'照片，只占1840至1900年间浩如烟海的人像摄影作品中的极小一部分。绝大多数照片中的人物都在彩绘背景前摆着痛苦而僵硬的姿势，或是茫然地凝视着远方。
vast.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

vast.sentenceEn: That is before we look for the space to grow the grains, sugars, seeds and oils that provide us with the vast bulk of our current calorie intake.
vast.translationZh: 这还不算我们需要寻找土地来种植谷物、糖类、种子和油料作物——这些作物目前为我们提供了绝大部分的卡路里摄入。
vast.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

vast.sentenceEn: This isn't surprising, considering the basic mandatory high school curriculum leaves students with a poor understanding of the vast academic possibilities that await them in college.
vast.translationZh: 这并不奇怪，因为高中的基础必修课程使学生对大学中等待他们的广阔学术可能性缺乏充分了解。
vast.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

vast.sentenceEn: They should start by discarding California's lame argument that exploring the contents of a smartphone – a vast storehouse of digital information – is similar to, say, going through a suspect's purse.
vast.translationZh: 他们首先应当驳斥加利福尼亚州毫无说服力的论点，即查看智能手机（一个庞大的数字信息库）的内容类似于搜查嫌疑人的钱包。
vast.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

vision.sentenceEn: A citizen science-based approach can extend the field of vision and include more ideas and different brains to problem-solve and create, making innovation faster and more effective.
vision.translationZh: 基于公民科学的方法能够拓展视野，汇集更多创意和多元智慧来解决问题与创新，从而使创新过程更快、更有效。
vision.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

vision.sentenceEn: Passing vision tests also produced a similar decline in fatal crashes for those drivers, although there appeared to be no benefit from combining the two.
vision.translationZh: 通过视力测试也能使这些驾驶员的致命撞车事故率产生类似幅度的下降，不过将这两项措施结合起来似乎并无额外益处。
vision.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

vision.sentenceEn: It is hard to get right, and requires a remarkable degree of vision , as well as cooperation between city authorities, the private sector, community groups and cultural organisations.
vision.translationZh: 要做到恰到好处并非易事，这需要非凡的远见卓识，以及城市当局、私营部门、社区团体和文化组织之间的通力合作。
vision.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

vision.sentenceEn: AI " vision " today is not nearly as sophisticated as that of humans.
vision.translationZh: 如今人工智能的“视觉”远不如人类的视觉复杂精密。
vision.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

vision.sentenceEn: Such visions are based on the downsides of being unemployed in a society built on the concept of employment.
vision.translationZh: 这些设想所依据的，是在一个以就业为核心概念的社会中失业所带来的种种弊端。
vision.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

vision.sentenceEn: "You have the importation of terminology that historically used to be associated with non-profit organizations and religious organizations: terms like vision , values, passion, and purpose," said Khurana.
vision.translationZh: 库拉纳指出：“现在企业引入了一些历史上通常与非营利组织和宗教组织相关联的术语，比如愿景、价值观、激情和目标。”
vision.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

voluntary.sentenceEn: Whenever decisions are based on masses of data, "you quickly get into a lot of ethical questions," notes Tan Kiat How, chief executive of a Singapore-based agency that is helping the government develop a voluntary code for the ethical use of AI.
voluntary.translationZh: 新加坡某机构首席执行官陈杰豪指出，只要决策是基于海量数据做出的，“你很快就会陷入诸多伦理问题之中”。该机构正协助政府制定人工智能伦理使用自愿准则。
voluntary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

voluntary.sentenceEn: In Denmark, the United States, and a few other countries, it is trying to set voluntary standards for models and fashion images that rely more on peer pressure for enforcement.
voluntary.translationZh: 在丹麦、美国和其他一些国家，时尚行业正尝试为模特和时尚形象制定自愿性标准，这些标准的执行更多依赖同行压力。
voluntary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

voluntary.sentenceEn: They are only classified as voluntary part-time workers if they tell the survey taker they chose to work less than 35 hours a week.
voluntary.translationZh: 只有当受访者告知调查人员他们选择每周工作少于35小时时，他们才会被归类为自愿兼职工作者。
voluntary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

voluntary.sentenceEn: We know the difference between voluntary and involuntary part-time employment because people tell us.
voluntary.translationZh: 我们之所以能够区分自愿兼职和非自愿兼职，是因为受访者会告诉我们。
voluntary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

voluntary.sentenceEn: The issue of voluntary part-time relates to Obamacare because one of the main purposes was to allow people to get insurance outside of employment.
voluntary.translationZh: 自愿兼职工作的问题与奥巴马医改相关，因为该法案的主要目的之一就是让人们能够在工作之外获得医疗保险。
voluntary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

voluntary.sentenceEn: Last year, European Commission Vice President Viviane Reding issued a call to voluntary action.
voluntary.translationZh: 去年，欧盟委员会副主席维维亚娜·雷丁发出了自愿行动的号召。
voluntary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

vary.sentenceEn: The size or regularity of markets can vary from season to season, depending on the area's agricultural calendar, and you're likely to find different produce on sale at different times of the year.
vary.translationZh: 农贸市场的规模和举办频率会随季节变化，这取决于当地的农业生产周期，而且在一年中的不同时节，你可能会发现市场上售卖的农产品也各不相同。
vary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

vary.sentenceEn: It is true that CEO pay has gone up—top ones may make 300 times the pay of typical workers on average, and since the mid-1970s, CEO pay for large publicly traded American corporations has, by varying estimates, gone up by about 500%.
vary.translationZh: 确实，首席执行官的薪酬有所上涨——顶级CEO的薪酬平均可能是普通员工的300倍，而且自20世纪70年代中期以来，据各种不同估计，美国大型上市公司首席执行官的薪酬上涨了约500%。
vary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

vary.sentenceEn: Most importantly, it constantly modifies and enhances the games you play to build on the strengths you are developing – much like a(n) effective exercise routine requires you to increase resistance and vary your muscle use.
vary.translationZh: 最重要的是，它会不断调整和改进你所玩的游戏，以巩固你正在培养的能力——这很像一套有效的锻炼方案需要你增加阻力并变换肌肉的使用方式。
vary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

vary.sentenceEn: While the quality of legal journalism varies greatly, there is an undue reliance amongst many journalists on interpretations supplied to them by lawyers.
vary.translationZh: 尽管法律新闻报道的质量参差不齐，但许多记者却过度依赖律师提供的解读。
vary.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
vary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

vary.sentenceEn: Although the figure may vary , analysts do agree on another matter: that the number of the homeless is increasing.
vary.translationZh: 尽管具体数字可能有所不同，但分析人士在另一个问题上达成了共识：无家可归者的数量正在增加。
vary.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
vary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

vary.sentenceEn: During the late 1990s, national spending on social sciences and the humanities as a percentage of all research and development funds – including government, higher education, non-profit and corporate – varied from around 4% to 25%; in most European nations, it is about 15%.
vary.translationZh: 20世纪90年代末，各国在社会科学和人文科学上的支出占所有研发基金（包括政府、高等教育机构、非营利组织和企业的研发基金）的比例从4%到25%不等；在大多数欧洲国家，这一比例约为15%。

virtual.sentenceEn: For instance, as convenient and provocative, AI enables virtual try-on experiences where you can virtually test makeup, hairstyles, clothing, and even cosmetic procedures before making any physical changes.
virtual.translationZh: 例如，人工智能提供了既便捷又具启发性的体验，让你在进行任何实际改变之前，能够虚拟尝试化妆、发型、服装，甚至美容整形手术。
virtual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

virtual.sentenceEn: As desire paths criss-cross through both physical and virtual landscapes, they stand as a proof of the collective insistence on forging unconventional routes and embracing the spirit of communal choice.
virtual.translationZh: 当欲望小径在现实与虚拟空间中纵横交错，它们成为了集体坚持开辟非常规路线、拥抱共同选择精神的证明。
virtual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

virtual.sentenceEn: The best uses of 3D printers and virtual reality haven't been invented yet.
virtual.translationZh: 3D打印机和虚拟现实的最佳应用方式尚未被发明出来。
virtual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

virtual.sentenceEn: That would be the people who buy advertising from them – and Facebook and Google, the two virtual giants, dominate digital advertising to the disadvantage of all other media and entertainment companies.
virtual.translationZh: 他们的客户是那些从他们那里购买广告的人——而脸书和谷歌这两大虚拟巨头则主导着数字广告市场，这对其他所有媒体和娱乐公司都不利。
virtual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第8句

virtual.sentenceEn: Orin Kerr, a law professor, compares the explosion and accessibility of digital information in the 21st century with the establishment of automobile use as a virtual necessity of life in the 20th: The justices had to specify novel rules for the new personal domain of the passenger car then; they must sort out how the Fourth Amendment applies to digital information now.
virtual.translationZh: 法学教授奥林·克尔将21世纪数字信息的爆炸式增长与普及性，与20世纪汽车成为生活必备品的情况相提并论：当时法官们不得不为轿车这一新的个人领域制定全新规则；如今他们必须解决第四修正案如何适用于数字信息的问题。
virtual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

virtual.sentenceEn: Given the current divorce rate of nearly 50 percent, that amounts to millions of cases in the United States every year – a virtual epidemic of failed conversation.
virtual.translationZh: 鉴于目前近50%的离婚率，这意味着美国每年有数百万起离婚案例——可以说这是一场由沟通失败引发的流行病。
virtual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

vote.sentenceEn: The state Legislature recently voted against a bill that would've made it illegal for towns to create legislation restricting short-term rentals.
vote.translationZh: 州议会最近投票否决了一项法案，该法案本将使城镇制定限制短期租赁的法规成为非法行为。
vote.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

vote.sentenceEn: However, the mechanisms proposed were unwieldy and the Bill was voted down following the change in government later that year.
vote.translationZh: 然而，该法案提出的机制过于繁琐，并且在当年晚些时候政府更迭后被否决。
vote.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

vote.sentenceEn: At issue before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit was the latest take of the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) on net neutrality, adopted on a party-line vote in 2017.
vote.translationZh: 提交给美国哥伦比亚特区巡回上诉法院的争议焦点是联邦通信委员会（FCC）于2017年通过党派投票方式采纳的最新网络中立性政策。
vote.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

vote.sentenceEn: If everything was going so well, then why did over 17 million people vote for Brexit, despite the warnings about what it could do to their country's economic prospects?
vote.translationZh: 如果一切真的如此向好，那么为何仍有超过1700万人投票支持英国脱欧，即便他们已收到脱欧可能对国家经济前景造成负面影响的警告？
vote.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

vote.sentenceEn: With Britain voting to leave the European Union, and GDP already predicted to slow as a result, it is now a timely moment to assess what he was referring to.
vote.translationZh: 随着英国公投决定退出欧盟，且预计此举将导致GDP增速放缓，现在正是审视他这番话含义的恰当时机。
vote.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

vote.sentenceEn: Slaves in the old days did not have the right to vote .
vote.translationZh: 旧时的奴隶没有选举权。
vote.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）

visual.sentenceEn: As an effective Washington operator, Hayden sensed that he could capitalize on the expedition's stunning visuals .
visual.translationZh: 作为一名在华盛顿颇具影响力的活动家，海登意识到他可以利用这次探险中令人惊叹的视觉资料。

visual.sentenceEn: Scientists are increasingly seeking out visual artists to help them communicate their work to new audiences.
visual.translationZh: 科学家们正越来越多地寻求视觉艺术家的帮助，以将他们的研究成果传达给新的受众。
visual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

visual.sentenceEn: The founders deliberately focused their projects around light—hence the " visual studies" in the name.
visual.translationZh: 创始人特意将他们的项目围绕“光”展开——因此机构名称中才有“视觉研究”一词。
visual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

visual.sentenceEn: More than half a century ago, the Massachusetts Institute of Technology opened its Center for Advanced Visual Studies (CAVS) to explore the role of technology in culture.
visual.translationZh: 半个多世纪前，麻省理工学院成立了高级视觉研究中心（CAVS），旨在探索科技在文化中的作用。
visual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

visual.sentenceEn: In it, a mother is asked to interact with her child in a normal way before putting on a blank expression and not giving them any visual social feedback: The child becomes increasingly distressed as she tries to capture her mother's attention.
visual.translationZh: 在这个实验中，母亲被要求先以正常方式与孩子互动，然后摆出毫无表情的面孔，不给孩子任何视觉社交反馈：孩子在试图吸引母亲注意时会变得越来越苦恼。
visual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

visual.sentenceEn: Visual recognition, reads the study, is "an automatic psychological process, occurring rapidly and intuitively with little or no apparent conscious deliberation".
visual.translationZh: 该研究指出，视觉识别是“一种自动的心理过程，它快速且直观地发生，几乎或完全没有明显的有意识思考”。
visual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

vital.sentenceEn: Librarians' selfless devotion can act against us when users point to universality of access by holding up a cell phone and saying, "it's all in here" as evidence that libraries are less vital for researchers today.
vital.translationZh: 当用户举起手机说“所有信息都在这里面”，以此证明图书馆对当今研究人员不再那么重要时，图书馆员无私奉献的精神反而可能对我们不利。
vital.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

vital.sentenceEn: Tipping has always been a vital source of income for workers in historically tipped services, like restaurants, where the tipped minimum wage can be as low as US$2.13 an hour.
vital.translationZh: 小费一直是传统小费服务行业工作者的重要收入来源，例如餐厅，这些行业的小费最低工资标准可低至每小时2.13美元。
vital.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

vital.sentenceEn: Only recently have they come to see the vital part forests will have to play in storing carbon.
vital.translationZh: 直到最近，他们才开始认识到森林在碳储存方面必须发挥的关键作用。
vital.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

vital.sentenceEn: That's only a small share of the total acreage that could benefit, about half a million acres in all, so it will be vital to prioritize areas at greatest risk of fire or drought.
vital.translationZh: 这仅仅是可受益总面积中的一小部分，总共约50万英亩，因此，优先处理火灾或干旱风险最高的区域将至关重要。
vital.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

vital.sentenceEn: This is why repeated attempts at reform legislation have failed in recent years, leaving the Postal Service unable to pay its bills except by deferring vital modernization.
vital.translationZh: 这就是近年来多次改革立法尝试均以失败告终的原因，使得邮政总局除了推迟至关重要的现代化进程外，几乎无力支付账单。
vital.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

vital.sentenceEn: Written accounts contain vital clues for donkey research.
vital.translationZh: 文献记载为驴的研究提供了关键线索。

vulnerable.sentenceEn: Certain artifacts are especially vulnerable because some pioneers in plastic art didn't always know how to mix ingredients properly, says Thea van Oosten, a polymer chemist who, until retiring a few years ago, worked for decades at the Cultural Heritage Agency of the Netherlands (RCE).
vulnerable.translationZh: 荷兰文化遗产局（RCE）的高分子化学家西娅·范·奥斯滕（Thea van Oosten）表示，某些文物特别脆弱，因为塑料艺术的一些先驱者并不总是知道如何正确调配材料。她在该局工作了数十年，于几年前退休。
vulnerable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

vulnerable.sentenceEn: It's especially vulnerable to light damage, and by the mid-1990s, Gilardi's pumpkins, roses, and other figures were splitting and crumbling.
vulnerable.translationZh: 这种泡沫特别容易受到光照损害，到20世纪90年代中期，吉拉迪创作的南瓜、玫瑰及其他形象已经开始开裂破碎。
vulnerable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

vulnerable.sentenceEn: Among other weaknesses, the measures cities must employ when left to tackle dirty air on their own are politically controversial, and therefore vulnerable .
vulnerable.translationZh: 在诸多缺陷中，当城市被迫独自应对空气污染问题时所必须采取的措施具有政治争议性，因此很容易被推翻。
vulnerable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

vulnerable.sentenceEn: And yet, John Hagel, author of The Power of Pull and other books, says Brynjolfsson and McAfee miss the reason why these jobs are so vulnerable to technology in the first place.
vulnerable.translationZh: 然而，《拉动力》及其他著作的作者约翰·哈格尔（John Hagel）指出，布林约尔松和麦卡菲（Brynjolfsson and McAfee）忽略了这些工作岗位为何首先如此容易受到技术冲击的根本原因。
vulnerable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

vulnerable.sentenceEn: The plan has also been greeted with skepticism by some computer security experts, who worry that the "voluntary ecosystem" envisioned by Mr. Schmidt would still leave much of the Internet vulnerable .
vulnerable.translationZh: 该计划也受到了一些计算机安全专家的质疑，他们担心施密特先生所构想的“自愿生态系统”仍会使互联网的大部分区域处于脆弱状态。
vulnerable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

vulnerable.sentenceEn: Women are biologically more vulnerable to stress.
vulnerable.translationZh: 从生理角度而言，女性更容易受到压力的影响。
vulnerable.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）

valley.sentenceEn: Rivkin joined the MPA in 2017 after the organization failed five years earlier to build consensus between Hollywood and Silicon Valley to win passage of legislation in Congress aimed at stopping online piracy.
valley.translationZh: 里夫金于2017年加入美国电影协会(MPA)，而该协会五年前曾试图在好莱坞和硅谷之间建立共识，以推动旨在制止在线盗版的法案在国会获得通过，但未能成功。
valley.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

valley.sentenceEn: When Microsoft bought task management app Wunderlist and mobile calendar Sunrise in 2015, it picked two newcomers that were attracting considerable buzz in Silicon Valley .
valley.translationZh: 2015年，微软收购任务管理应用Wunderlist和移动日历应用Sunrise时，选中的是两家在硅谷已引起不小轰动的新兴企业。
valley.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

valley.sentenceEn: Humans overwhelmingly live in valleys , and on supplies of fresh water.
valley.translationZh: 绝大多数人类都居住在山谷中，依靠淡水为生。
valley.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

valley.sentenceEn: Olduvai Gorge, an early hominid site in Tanzania, was found by a butterfly hunter who literally fell into its deep valley in 1911.
valley.translationZh: 奥杜瓦伊峡谷是坦桑尼亚的一处早期古人类遗址，1911年由一位捕蝶人意外发现——他实实在在地掉进了这个深谷。

valley.sentenceEn: Carter sifted through rubble in the Valley of the Kings for seven years before he located the tomb in 1922.
valley.translationZh: 卡特在帝王谷的碎石堆中仔细搜寻了七年，终于在1922年找到了这座陵墓。

valley.sentenceEn: In another case, American archaeologists René Million and George Cowgill spent years systematically mapping the entire city of Teotihuacán in the Valley of Mexico near what is now Mexico City.
valley.translationZh: 在另一个案例中，美国考古学家勒内·米利翁和乔治·考吉尔花费数年时间，对墨西哥谷特奥蒂瓦坎古城进行了系统性的全面测绘。这座古城位于如今墨西哥城附近。

verbal.sentenceEn: Like physical fights, verbal fights can leave both sides bloodied.
verbal.translationZh: 就像肢体冲突一样，言语争执也会让双方都伤痕累累。

verbal.sentenceEn: If we readjust our view of arguments – from a verbal fight or tennis game to a reasoned exchange through which we all gain mutual respect, and understanding – then we change the very nature of what it means to "win" an argument.
verbal.translationZh: 如果我们重新调整对争论的看法——从一场言语争斗或网球比赛转变为一种理性交流，通过这种交流我们都能获得相互尊重和理解——那么我们就改变了“赢得”一场争论的本质意义。

verbal.sentenceEn: "Parents don't have to be exquisitely present at all times, but there needs to be a balance and parents need to be responsive and sensitive to a child's verbal or nonverbal expressions of an emotional need," says Radesky.
verbal.translationZh: 拉德斯基说：“父母不必时时刻刻都全身心在场，但需要找到平衡，并且要能够对孩子通过语言或非语言方式表达的情感需求做出敏感的回应。”
verbal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

verbal.sentenceEn: She found that mothers who used devices during the exercise started 20 per cent fewer verbal and 39 per cent fewer nonverbal interactions with their children.
verbal.translationZh: 她发现，在实验过程中使用电子设备的母亲与孩子之间的语言交流减少了20%，非语言互动减少了39%。
verbal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

verbal.sentenceEn: IQ tests ask you to complete verbal and visual analogies, to envision paper after it has been folded and cut, and to deduce numerical sequences, among other similar tasks.
verbal.translationZh: 智商测试要求受试者完成语言和视觉类比、想象纸张折叠和剪切后的形状、推断数字序列，以及完成其他类似任务。
verbal.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
verbal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

verbal.sentenceEn: In his article "How Intelligent Is Intelligence Testing?", Sternberg notes that traditional tests best assess analytical and verbal skills but fail to measure creativity and practical knowledge, components also critical to problem solving and life success.
verbal.translationZh: 在其《智力测试有多智能？》一文中，斯滕伯格指出，传统测试能很好地评估分析能力和语言能力，却无法衡量创造力和实践知识，而这些也是解决问题和人生成功的关键要素。
verbal.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
verbal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

violate.sentenceEn: Because the California law applies to all boards, even where there is no history of prior discrimination, courts are likely to rule that the law violates the constitutional guarantee of "equal protection".
violate.translationZh: 由于加州这项法律适用于所有董事会，甚至包括那些从未有过歧视历史的董事会，法院很可能会裁定该法律违反了宪法保障的“平等保护”原则。
violate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

violate.sentenceEn: On June 7 Google pledged not to "design or deploy AI" that would cause "overall harm," or to develop AI-directed weapons or use AI for surveillance that would violate international norms.
violate.translationZh: 6月7日，谷歌承诺不会“设计或部署”可能造成“全面伤害”的人工智能，也不会开发人工智能驱动的武器，或利用人工智能进行违反国际准则的监视活动。
violate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

violate.sentenceEn: It also pledged not to deploy AI whose use would violate international laws or human rights.
violate.translationZh: 谷歌还承诺不会部署其使用将违反国际法或人权的人工智能。
violate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

violate.sentenceEn: The court has ruled that police don't violate the Fourth Amendment when they go through the wallet or pocketbook of an arrestee without a warrant.
violate.translationZh: 最高法院曾裁定，警方在没有搜查令的情况下检查被捕者的钱包或皮夹并不违反《第四修正案》。
violate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

violate.sentenceEn: There are concerns that government, employers, and marketers might be able to access these data, thereby violating our privacy.
violate.translationZh: 人们担心政府、雇主和营销人员可能会获取这些数据，从而侵犯我们的隐私。
violate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

violate.sentenceEn: For example, it is unclear whether the sequencing of a whole genome violates the patents of individual genes within it.
violate.translationZh: 例如，目前尚不清楚对整个基因组进行测序是否会侵犯其中单个基因的专利权。
violate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

virtually.sentenceEn: For instance, as convenient and provocative, AI enables virtual try-on experiences where you can virtually test makeup, hairstyles, clothing, and even cosmetic procedures before making any physical changes.
virtually.translationZh: 例如，人工智能提供了既便捷又具启发性的体验，让你在进行任何实际改变之前，能够虚拟尝试化妆、发型、服装，甚至美容整形手术。
virtually.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

virtually.sentenceEn: Plus, virtually all major American companies are becoming tech companies, one way or another.
virtually.translationZh: 此外，几乎所有美国大公司都在以这样或那样的方式转型为科技公司。
virtually.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

virtually.sentenceEn: From career to community and family, these contrasts suggest that in the aftermath of the searing Great Recession, those just starting out in life are defining priorities and expectations that will increasingly spread through virtually all aspects of American life, from consumer preferences to housing patterns to politics.
virtually.translationZh: 从职业发展到社区生活再到家庭观念，这些差异表明，在灼痛人心的"大衰退"之后，那些刚刚踏入社会的年轻人正在确立自己的优先事项和期望，而这些观念将逐渐渗透到美国生活的方方面面，从消费偏好到住房模式，再到政治取向。
virtually.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

virtually.sentenceEn: In our contemporary culture, the prospect of communicating with – or even looking at – a stranger is virtually unbearable.
virtually.translationZh: 在当代文化中，与陌生人交流——甚至只是看他们一眼——几乎都让人难以忍受。
virtually.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

virtually.sentenceEn: Unfortunately, these critics are virtually forgotten.
virtually.translationZh: 不幸的是，这些评论家们如今已几乎被人遗忘。
virtually.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

virtually.sentenceEn: But in late September 2009, officials reported there was significant flu activity in almost every state and that virtually all the samples tested are the new swine flu, also known as (A) H1N1, not seasonal flu.
virtually.translationZh: 但到2009年9月末，官员们报告称几乎每个州都出现了显著的流感疫情，且几乎所有检测样本均为新型猪流感（也称为甲型H1N1流感），而非季节性流感。
virtually.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

volume.sentenceEn: Even as California lost a huge volume of production to other locations, there was still plenty of film production taking place in Los Angeles before this year.
volume.translationZh: 尽管加利福尼亚州流失了大量的影视制作业务到其他地区，但在今年之前，洛杉矶仍有大量的电影拍摄工作正在进行。
volume.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

volume.sentenceEn: In volume V he had attached an appendix, The Scovell Ciphers.
volume.translationZh: 在第五卷中，他附上了一个名为《斯科维尔密码》的附录。
volume.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

volume.sentenceEn: Just as the code breaking has its wider relevance in the struggle for Spain, so his attempts to make his way up the promotion ladder speak volumes about British society.
volume.translationZh: 正如密码破译在西班牙争夺战中具有更广泛的意义一样，斯科维尔在军阶晋升之路上的种种努力也充分反映了英国社会的风貌。
volume.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

volume.sentenceEn: The sheer volume of available choice is enough to send shoppers into a state of information overload.
volume.translationZh: 如此海量的选择足以让购物者陷入信息过载的状态。
volume.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

volume.sentenceEn: Beethoven's habit of increasing the volume with an extreme intensity and then abruptly following it with a sudden soft passage was only rarely used by composers before him.
volume.translationZh: 贝多芬习惯将音量增强到极致强度，然后突然转入一段轻柔的乐段，这种手法在他之前的作曲家作品中极为罕见。
volume.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

volume.sentenceEn: This slim volume is packed with tips to help wage slaves as well as lottery winners get the most "happiness bang for your buck."
